---
title: "5 · Unsupervised Learning"
code-tools: false
toc: false
---

Learning from data without labels. Principal component analysis (the covariance matrix, its eigenvectors and the variance they keep), t-SNE (neighbour probabilities, the Kullback–Leibler loss, the crowding problem and the heavy tail of the Student-t, perplexity), clustering with k-means and DBSCAN and its evaluation with the silhouette and the adjusted Rand index, and autoencoders: compression into a latent space and anomaly detection by the reconstruction error. Data: MNIST, CIFAR-10, blood cells, credit-card transactions and the gene expression of 801 tumours.
